comparison.objective: Candidate commissions an industrial shock absorber; pr-1151 purges air from a syringe while preserving liquid and returning the syringe to its rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses tool insertion, collar adjustment, locking torque, and repeated dynamic testing. pr-1151 uses syringe orientation, bimanual barrel support, controlled plunger advance, and spill/loss management.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks stopping behavior, stroke, hard-stop avoidance, and setting retention. pr-1151 checks residual air, sample loss, prohibited aspiration, returned pose, release, and a one-second hold. Candidate leaves several response and retention thresholds undeclared.
comparison.reason: The objectives, force interactions, manipulated mechanisms, failure modes, and measured outcomes are unrelated beyond generic bimanual force control.
